item.title: OUR MIRAGE Celebrate Release of New Album with Single ‘The Chase’, Feat. Elwood Stray
item.description: Our Mirage have entered their next era with the release of their brand-new album Fractured Minds – a record that doesn’t just continue their rise, but cements their status as one of the most impactful metalcore acts on a global scale. item.title: CLAWFINGER Release New Single ‘Going Down (Like Titanic)’ from Long-Awaited Comeback Album
item.description: Following the success of previously-released singles ‘Scum’, ‘Ball & Chain’ and ‘Big Brother’, Swedish-Norwegian rap-metal pioneers CLAWFINGER have released their latest single ‘Going Down (Like Titanic)’. The song is taken from their hotly-anticipated studio album Before We All Die, set for release on February 20 via PERCEPTION – A Division Of Reigning Phoenix Music. Before We All Die marks CLAWFINGER’s first studio album in 19 years, capturing the band’s […]

item.title: GRAIN OF PAIN Announces New Album “Behind Us All” + Unleashes Video for Haunting First Single ‘To Burn Inside’
item.description: Finnish doom metal outfit GRAIN OF PAIN has announced the release of its new full-length album, “Behind Us All”, set to drop on March 27 via Noble Demon. item.description: Swedish rock quintet Hällas have released their fourth full-length Panaroma, via their own label Äventyr Records.
